mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 275.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy and eroding equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 275.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with a strong labor market, which typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: The interaction term between FEDFUNDS and UNRATE does not have a statistically significant negative coefficient (p>0.05) in a regression of 20d returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of labor market tightness (unemployment rate below 4.5%), a further decline in the unemployment rate signals accelerating wage pressures and potential inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5 and UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts figure below 1600.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market and broader consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1600.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in INDPRO decline periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 275.0), a federal funds rate above 0.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 275.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between HOUST and RSAFS does not have a statistically significant negative coefficient (p>0.05) in a regression of 20d returns, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.
